description: Draft of spec 014's study plan (tuning seed 333 only).

man2.what: Annex B's manoeuvre statistics (the search's prior is right)

shift.what: shorter legs (mean 15 min), smaller turns (15 to 75 degrees), faster turn rates, more speed changes: the search's prior is wrong

quiet.what: the target holds course for the whole engagement (spec 014 FR-009)

man2-corr.what: Annex B data with correlated bearing errors (60 s, half the variance)

man2-out.what: Annex B data with 2% outlying bearings (10 sd)

references.note: frozen for 10-second MAN2 real-time rows; run here on 10-second points, smoothed backwards (ekf-rts) and read as a track; not re-tuned
